name: Drop
summary: A build that pulls everything tight, a moment of near-silence, then everything lands at once.
motif: The riff is teased in the build (thinned, filtered in the sound stage, missing its last note) and played whole in the drop.
surprise: The bar before the drop keeps only one sound from the riff, so the drop answers it.
ending: The outro strips back to the riff alone.
